scripts.build: pnpm --filter @aiops-lms/observability build && pnpm --filter @aiops-lms/course build && pnpm --filter @aiops-lms/auth build && pnpm --filter @aiops-lms/gateway build && pnpm --filter @aiops-lms/enrollment build
scripts.ci:verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.test: pnpm run test:architecture && pnpm --filter @aiops-lms/observability test && node --experimental-vm-modules ./node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config services/course/jest.config.ts && node --experimental-vm-modules ./node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config services/auth/jest.config.ts && node --experimental-vm-modules ./node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config services/gateway/jest.config.ts && node --experimental-vm-modules ./node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config services/enrollment/jest.config.ts && pnpm run test:w1 && pnpm run test:telemetry
scripts.test:w1:postgres: pnpm --filter @aiops-lms/observability build && pnpm --filter @aiops-lms/auth build && node services/auth/test/reset-w1-postgres.mjs && node --experimental-vm-modules ./node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config jest.w1-postgres.config.ts
scripts.test:w2:postgres: pnpm run build && node services/auth/test/reset-w1-postgres.mjs && node services/course/test/reset-w2-postgres.mjs && node --experimental-vm-modules ./node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config jest.w2-postgres.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && node --experimental-vm-modules ./node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config services/course/jest-e2e.config.ts && node services/course/test/telemetry/http.telemetry-test.mjs
scripts.test:telemetry: pnpm run build && node services/course/test/telemetry/http.telemetry-test.mjs && node services/course/test/telemetry/dependency.telemetry-test.mjs && node services/auth/test/telemetry/http.telemetry-test.mjs
